description: Lexical routing cases for consequential completion claims and routine negative controls. These do not measure semantic over-invocation, evidence reuse, or agent performance.
notes: Run with the ranking model. Positive cases assert the intended winner; empty-trigger controls use the scorer floor. Use behavioral-scenarios.md to assess the runtime contract separately; passing this fixture does not establish that a model avoids unnecessary ceremony.
